name: Pelts for the guild
description: The warrior guild's hall is new timber and an empty wall. Eirik Stonehand wants four wolf pelts from the Frostmere Wilds to line it.
objective: Wolf pelts from the Frostmere Wilds
reward: 15 copper, 40 experience, and your choice of a wolf-head helm or a wolf-hide jerkin

name: Teeth at the Gate
description: Frost wolves are on the roads outside every gate. Sigrun wants them culled. Old Brand Kettilsson, by the north gate, will take five pelts.
objective: Five wolf pelts for Old Brand
reward: 25 copper and 60 experience from Old Brand

name: The Missing Scout
description: A scout did not come back from the frozen camp north of the gate. The fire is cold. Something was written down.
objective: Read the journal at the frozen scout camp and tell Sigrun

name: Icebound Cairns
description: The journal spoke of blue light, and the cairns are full of barrow-dead. Put eight of them down. Yrsa, in Sigrid's hall, has a blade for the one who does.
objective: Barrow-dead put down in the Icebound Cairns
reward: Yrsa's rune blade, 40 copper, and 120 experience

name: The Rimeheart
description: Blue lights under the ice at Rimeheart Lake. Ysolde of the Black Ice serves the Shadow King there. She is not the wizard of Hoffender. End her and come back.
